findings.title: The checkpoint claims completion before independent QA passes
findings.criterion_ref: Criterion 7 forbids claiming completion when the independent gate has not produced a witnessed and verified `QA_PASSED` result; criterion 3 says an inconclusive check is not PASS.
findings.trigger: Commit `ee8922a` is treated as the completed P03 delta while Test 8 remains in progress.
findings.consequence: The completion claim and commit ordering violate the independent gate, leaving Test 8 and the checkpoint completion condition unsatisfied.
findings.evidence: The commit subject is `refactor(repo): complete P03 source move`, while Test 8 states “In progress.” The report expressly acknowledges committing before the planned `QA_PASSED` ordering. No witnessed verification identifies v4 as `QA_PASSED`.

findings.title: Required procedures within Tests 1–6 remain unrecorded
findings.criterion_ref: Criterion 3 requires every prompt test’s exact command or inspection procedure, exit status, material output, and supported conclusion.
findings.trigger: The literal procedures required by Tests 1, 2, 3, and 6 are checked against v4’s recorded evidence.
findings.consequence: Those PASS conclusions cannot be fully reproduced or supported from the gated report.
findings.evidence: Test 1 uses an informal manual cross-reference without an exact expansion/comparison procedure or status. Test 2 does not record P03’s required pre-move comparison of the live P02 dry-run candidates and current AST inventory. Test 3 does not record the required file-mode comparison. Test 6 records help and invalid-flag checks but omits the prompt-required no-mutation preflight procedure, exit status, and material output.

findings.title: The purported final path ledger omits the current post-commit checkpoint delta
findings.criterion_ref: Criterion 2 requires every changed, created, moved, and deleted path and proof of authorization; criterion 6 requires post-change git status.
findings.trigger: The current worktree is inspected after v4 and round-4 evidence were generated.
findings.consequence: The supplied 223-path commit ledger is not the complete delta for the artifact being judged, and the report’s claim that the worktree is empty is false.
findings.evidence: Current `git status --porcelain` has 10 entries, including deletion of `P03_checkpoint_report.v3.md`, creation of v4 and its deprecated predecessor, QA round-4 files, new diff-tree evidence, new t3 evidence, and modified execution/QA state. None is represented by the commit-only ledger for `ee8922a`. The report nevertheless states `git status --porcelain` is empty.

findings.title: Immutable digest coverage does not include the artifact and evidence being judged
findings.criterion_ref: Criterion 6 requires a reviewable diff or immutable digest for every deliverable.
findings.trigger: The v4 report, t3 evidence, round-4 QA files, and new diff-tree manifests are authenticated against commit `ee8922a`.
findings.consequence: The exact checkpoint artifact and its supporting evidence are not covered by the claimed immutable deliverable manifest.
findings.evidence: `git cat-file -e ee8922a:plans_internal/refactor_repo/checkpoints/P03/P03_checkpoint_report.v4.md` fails because v4 is not in the commit. The two `commit_diff_tree_*` manifests and `t3_post_commit/` evidence are likewise untracked post-commit files. The report’s assertion that these files are committed as part of the checkpoint is therefore false, and no complete external digest manifest covers them.

observations: P03-QA-001 is resolved: the post-commit t3 comparison records exactly the 29 amended P04 allowlist IDs and no additional new failure.
The prompt now includes its own path in the amended authorization list, resolving the specific unauthorized-self-edit defect from round 3.
The substantive compatibility corrections appear to have eliminated the earlier six non-P04 regressions.
reasoning: The prior-round record matches all three verdicts I issued. The core regression boundary is now satisfied, but the actual v4 checkpoint state diverges from its claimed clean, committed state. Several expressly required test procedures also remain absent, and the artifact claims completion through its commit while independent QA is still pending.
